About Blueprint 

 Blueprint is a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with teams across the United States. We help organizations turn complex challenges into meaningful outcomes by connecting strategy and execution across AI, cloud, data, product development, and emerging technology. 

 Our culture is built by people who care deeply about doing exceptional work. We set high standards, take ownership, and continually challenge ourselves and one another to be better. We work hard, support each other, and take genuine pride in what we deliver for our clients, partners, and teams. 

 At Blueprint, you’ll work alongside talented people with different experiences, expertise, and perspectives. You’ll have opportunities to take on meaningful challenges, expand your skills, and see the impact of what you build. 

 Bring your perspective. Raise the standard. Build what matters. 

 
 In This Role

 You will contribute to the development of AI training datasets by building and maintaining Python-based data processing pipelines. You will work with large-scale structured and unstructured datasets, transforming raw documents and text into high-quality, validated data for AI model training. This role requires hands-on experience creating datasets from the ground up, developing scalable data workflows, and managing data processing in Azure environments. You will collaborate with data scientists and engineering partners to improve data quality, processing efficiency, and dataset reliability while ensuring data integrity, traceability, and security.

 Responsibilities

 
 
 
 
 Design, develop, maintain, and optimize Python-based data pipelines for large-scale data ingestion, processing, and transformation.







 
 
 
 Build datasets from the ground up by collecting, organizing, cleaning, validating, and preparing raw structured and unstructured data.







 
 
 
 Develop workflows for OCR processing, text extraction, normalization, filtering, segmentation, and deduplication.







 
 
 
 Execute and monitor large-scale batch processing jobs, troubleshoot failures, and implement automated retry and recovery mechanisms.







 
 
 
 Develop automated data quality checks to identify missing or corrupted files, incomplete processing outputs, duplicate records, formatting issues, and metadata inconsistencies.







 
 
 
 Prepare high-quality, training-ready datasets through data filtering, tokenization, text segmentation, and conversion into standardized formats.







 
 
 
 Manage bulk data uploads, downloads, and synchronization between local processing environments and Azure storage platforms.







 
 
 
 Maintain organized datasets with consistent naming conventions, metadata, version control, and source traceability.







 
 
 
 Optimize data processing performance, memory utilization, storage efficiency, and cloud resource consumption.







 
 
 
 Monitor dataset statistics, processing coverage, quality metrics, and exceptions while generating operational reports.







 
 
 
 Collaborate with applied scientists and engineering teams to translate AI training requirements into scalable and repeatable data workflows.







 
 
 
 Maintain documented, tested, and version-controlled code while following established data security and governance requirements.







 
 Qualifications

 
 
 
 
 5+ years of professional experience in data engineering, data pipeline development, or data science with substantial hands-on programming responsibilities.







 
 
 
 Strong proficiency in Python, including developing reusable modules, debugging, testing, logging, and error handling.







 
 
 
 Demonstrated experience building and developing datasets from scratch, including data ingestion, cleaning, transformation, validation, and preparation.







 
 
 
 Hands-on experience processing large-scale structured and unstructured datasets using memory-efficient, parallel, or distributed processing techniques.







 
 
 
 Practical experience with Azure Blob Storage or Azure Data Lake Storage, including bulk data transfers, storage organization, and access troubleshooting.







 
 
 
 Experience with Python data-processing libraries and formats such as pandas, NumPy, JSON/JSONL, CSV, and Parquet.







 
 
 
 Working knowledge of SQL, Git, Linux environments, and command-line tools.







 
 
 
 Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills with a focus on data quality and integrity.







 
 
 
 Ability to communicate technical challenges and collaborate effectively with cross-functional engineering and data science teams.







 
 Preferred Qualifications

 
 
 
 
 Experience developing OCR pipelines, processing scanned documents, multilingual text, or document-layout data.







 
 
 
 Experience with Azure Databricks, Azure Machine Learning, Azure Data Factory, or other workflow orchestration platforms.







 
 
 
 Familiarity with Hugging Face Datasets, AI/ML tokenization, near-duplicate detection, and training/evaluation data separation.







 
 
 
 Experience with large-scale dataset curation and preparation for AI or machine learning model training.







 
 
 
 Knowledge of distributed data processing frameworks and technologies such as PySpark.







 
 
 
 Experience with dataset lineage, reproducibility, containerized environments, and CI/CD practices.







 
 
 
 Experience optimizing data pipelines for performance, reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency.







 


 Salary Range   

 At Blueprint, we strive to offer competitive pay that reflects the value of our team members. Compensation for this role is influenced by a variety of factors, including skills, education, responsibilities, experience, and geographic market. For candidates based in Washington State, the anticipated salary range is  $150,000– $160,000 USD/Annually.   Please note that we typically do not hire new employees at the top of the posted range. Actual starting pay will be determined based on experience, skills, and internal equity. The final salary and job title may vary depending on the selected candidate’s qualifications and could fall outside the stated range. 

 Equal Opportunity Employer   

 Blueprint Technologies, LLC is an equal employment opportunity employer. Qualified applicants are considered without regard to race, color, age, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, orientation, veteran/military status, religion, national origin, ancestry, marital, or familial status, genetic information, citizenship, or any other status protected by law.  

 If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation to complete the application process, please reach out to:  recruiting@bpcs.com   

 Blueprint believe in the importance of a healthy and happy team, which is why our comprehensive benefits package includes:  

 
 Medical, dental, and vision coverage  

 Flexible Spending Account  

 401k program  

 Competitive PTO offerings  

 Parental Leave  

 Opportunities for professional growth and development  

 
 Location:  5 days onsite at Seattle, WA 
 Benefits 

 Blueprint believes that healthy, supported employees do their best work. Eligible employees have access to a comprehensive benefits package that may include: 

 
 Medical, dental, and vision coverage 

 Flexible Spending Account (FSA) 

 401(k) retirement plan 

 Competitive paid time off 

 Parental leave 

 Professional growth and development opportunities 

 
 Benefits and eligibility may vary based on role, employment status, and location. 

 Equal Employment Opportunity 

 Blueprint Technologies, LLC is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital or familial status, military or veteran status, citizenship status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. 

 Applicant Accommodations 

 If you need a reasonable accommodation to participate in any part of the application or interview process, please contact recruiting@bpcs.com.
